LESSON: RELATIONS WITH PEOPLE OF OTHER FAITHS

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalaat (Social Relations)
Topic 6.2: Relations with people of other faiths

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Relations with people of other faiths. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Relations with people of other faiths
2. Practise Relations with people of other faiths at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Relations with people of other faiths

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Relations with people of other faiths
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Relations with people of other faiths. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Relations with people of other faiths at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Relations with people of other faiths at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Relations with people of other faiths
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Relations with people of other faiths. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Relations with people of other faiths using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Relations with people of other faiths in the examples.
2. Explain Relations with people of other faiths to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Relations with people of other faiths.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Relations with people of other faiths using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Relations with people of other faiths important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Relations with people of other faiths
2. Practise Relations with people of other faiths at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Relations with people of other faiths

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
